memgraph_parity.label: Memgraph Community @ parity
memgraph_parity.notes: In-memory storage engine, so the RAM cap is an absolute dataset ceiling rather than a page-cache constraint. Memgraph publishes an exact formula - StorageRAMUsage = (Vertices x 204B) + (Edges x 154B) - so the fit can be proven arithmetically before loading. At scale S that is roughly 30 MB.
